apartment_name.title: Apartment Name
apartment_name.description: Apartment in this manager's buildings. Empty unless result_code is found.

case_subjects.title: Case Subjects
case_subjects.description: Case subjects for that apartment, separated by a semicolon. Empty when there are none.

case_table.title: Case Table
case_table.description: Case rows for that apartment. Each row is Case Number, Subject, Status, and Created Date, separated by ' | '. Rows are separated by '; '.

city.title: City
city.description: City of that apartment. Empty unless result_code is found.

earliest_due.title: Earliest Due
earliest_due.description: Earliest Date_Due__c, used as the tenancy start for the Oregon first-year rule.

past_due_count.title: Past Due Count
past_due_count.description: Count of Past_Due__c payments on that apartment.

rent.title: Rent
rent.description: Current monthly rent. Empty unless result_code is found.

result_code.title: Result Code
result_code.description: found, not_found, ambiguous, or no_payment_history. not_found means the tenant is not in this manager's buildings. no_payment_history means the apartment is in these buildings and has no payment rows, so there is no renewal decision.

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: warm, strict, or decline. Use this for a draft. Do not choose a different tone.
